name: mcp-oauth
description: MCP OAuth 2.1 authorization server for mcp.diegonmarcos.com (option 31.1, approved 2026-10-28): RFC 8414/9728 discovery, RFC 7591 DCR, /authorize behind Authelia, PKCE S256 /token, opaque tokens introspected by introspect-proxy
_status: approved/live: owner approved option 31.1 on 2026-10-28; runtime needs dist/.secrets (INTROSPECT_SECRET, FORM_SECRET) provisioned on gcp-proxy via secrets.yaml
_ship_skip: parked (#1252): deploy.host local keeps Ship from building/deploying this service (same marker as infra-cloud_gcloud and infra-bld_cloud-builder-x; build-gha.json then omits it). Restore host gcp-proxy and remote_path /opt/containers/mcp-oauth together with provisioning dist/.secrets (INTROSPECT_SECRET, FORM_SECRET) on gcp-proxy.

unit.cmd: python3 -m pip install -q flask==3.0.0 'PyJWT[crypto]==2.9.0' pytest && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider test

api.description: OAuth 2.1 AS for MCP connectors (claude.ai, claude.com, localhost). Public paths are exactly the mcp.diegonmarcos.com entry of caddy_config.edge_auth.public_open; /introspect is mesh-only.
